userStories.title: As a Service Agent, I want to search by a single-record identifier so that I can retrieve the correct customer and account summary quickly
As an Account Management Specialist, I want the customer summary and related account summary shown together in the workspace so that I can review servicing context without switching to legacy tools
As an Account Management Specialist, I want to open Mimir and other protected modules from the workspace with shared identity context so that I can complete related servicing tasks efficiently
As a Service Agent, I want the unified workspace to preserve my session and page context while I move across supported CM and AM screens so that I can complete servicing work with less interruption
As a Compliance Role, I want all protected customer and account access events recorded in an immutable audit trail so that the organization can support security and privacy reviews
As a System Administrator, I want the web workspace rollout controlled with versioned APIs and feature flags so that supported legacy CM and AM functions can transition safely
As a System Administrator, I want monitoring for workspace availability and lookup performance so that the unified web workspace meets operational resilience targets
As a Service Agent, I want to sign in to the unified CM and AM web workspace with enterprise SSO so that I can start customer and account servicing from one secure entry point
As a System Administrator, I want JWT-backed application sessions validated on protected workspace requests so that only authenticated identities can use CM and AM functions
As an Account Management Specialist, I want the workspace home page to show only the CM, AM, and related modules I am allowed to use so that I can enter servicing functions quickly and securely
